title: Fuzzer: Use-after-free when freeing `CanvasLayer` with a queued custom viewport
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.8.dev.custom_build. (26228372b)

### System information

Ubuntu 26.04

### Issue description

This one took me three days to track down because of bugs in my minimizer, which was randomly removing lines that were actually required to reproduce the issue.

I've seen other issues with very similar backtraces, but I doubt they have the same root cause. They are likely also use-after-free bugs, but I don't think they are caused by the same `CanvasLayer`/`Window` classes.

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

var _tick: int = 0

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	match _tick:
		0:
			var _v7729 = ClassDB.instantiate("CanvasLayer")
			add_child(_v7729)
			var _v7730 = ClassDB.instantiate("Window")
			_v7729.set_custom_viewport.call(_v7730)
			_v7730.queue_free()
			_v7729.queue_free()
	for c in get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	_tick += 1
	if _tick >= 1:
		get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
